name: facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack/src/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.build_baegarg2019: build a BAE adversarial attack using WordSwapMaskedLM with part-of-speech and USE constraints for untargeted classification
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.build_attack: build a BERT-style adversarial attack with BAE transformation supporting both targeted and untargeted classification goals
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.USE_compute_sim: compute the mean cosine similarity between clean and adversarial text embeddings using Universal Sentence Encoder
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.USE_init: initialize a Universal Sentence Encoder model loaded from TensorFlow Hub for semantic similarity computation
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.review_build_attack: review the build_attack function to understand how targeted vs untargeted classification attacks are configured

facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.load_data_dbpedia14: load the dbpedia14 dataset from CSV files with label, title, and sentence columns
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.load_data_ag_news: load the ag_news dataset for news classification with 4 classes
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.load_data_imdb: load the imdb dataset for movie review sentiment analysis with 2 classes
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.load_data_yelp: load the yelp_polarity dataset for review sentiment classification with 2 classes
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.load_data_mnli: load the mnli dataset from GLUE for natural language inference with 3 classes

facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.load_gpt2_from_dict: load a GPT-2 language model from a saved state dictionary file with configurable hidden states
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.bool_flag: parse a command line string argument into a boolean value accepting on off true false 0 1
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.target_offset: offset all label values in an examples dictionary by subtracting one from each
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.get_output_file: generate a checkpoint output file path based on model dataset attack and hyperparameter arguments
facebookresearch_text-adversarial-attack.load_checkpoints: load and aggregate adversarial attack checkpoint files from a folder returning logits texts and labels
